en.title: Stop waiting, Lugi – the star signing is needed already this winter

sv.title: Svenska Innebandyförbundet vill höja kravet på skyddsglasögon till 20 år

en.title: Swedish Floorball Federation wants to raise eye protection requirement to age 20
en.summary: At the beginning of December, the Swedish Floorball Federation will vote on raising the requirement for eyewear during matches from 16 to 20 years. en.title: Henrik Rydström's double grief: “Awe for life”
en.summary: Hammarby coach Henrik Rydström is searching for words. – I don't know how to say this because all words feel inadequate, but I am just so grateful for everything my parents did for me, he says in the end. Early in the year, the gold-chasing coach lost his father.
